text: 从北交所了解到，首批北交所三个月持有期主题基金已确定8家管理人，包括华夏、汇添富、易方达、南方、嘉实、东财、富国、中信建投基金。7月24日起，相关基金管理人将向证监会正式递交产品注册申请材料。（证券时报）
text_en: The Beijing Stock Exchange confirmed the eight managers for the first batch of BSE three-month holding period thematic funds: China Asset Management, China Universal, E Fund, Southern, Harvest, East Money, Fullgoal, and CSC Financial. Starting July 24, the relevant fund managers will formally submit product registration application materials to the CSRC. (Securities Times)
